candidates.title: Art Futures Camp 2026 – Diriyah Art Futures
candidates.organizer: Diriyah Art Futures (DAF) | Ministry of Culture
candidates.summary: Art Futures Summer Camp for Arabic-Speaking Teens is a three-week immersive programme hosted by Diriyah Art Futures (DAF), the MENA region’s first centre dedicated to New Media Arts. Designed for Arabic-speaking teens aged 14–18, the camp offers an in-depth introduction to digital art practices in a dynamic and supportive environment. Under the 2026 theme, “Digital Art and Portraiture,” participants explore new ways of representing identity in the digital age, questioning how individuals are portrayed when faces become data and images circulate beyond physical presence. The programme combines creative experimentation with foundational technical skills, including Fab Lab practices and digital studio portraiture. Throughout the camp, participants work closely with industry specialists and creative mentors, culminating in a collaborative exhibition produced with DAF’s curatorial and exhibition teams to showcase their work. Applications are officially open, with aspiring young creatives in Riyadh able to apply until Sunday, June 7.

Through a variety of interactive activity stations, children will discover heritage-inspired crafts including pottery, Al Sadu weaving, traditional incense burner (mabkharah) making, Najdi door decoration, and other traditional art forms. candidates.venue: Saudi Falcons Club in Malham - Riyadh
candidates.summary: International Falcon Breeders Auction 2026 takes place from August 5 to 25, bringing together elite breeders, leading local farms, and renowned international falcon producers in Riyadh. Organized by the Saudi Falcons Club, the event celebrates the Kingdom’s rich falconry heritage while reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a global hub for falconry excellence. The auction has become a trusted international platform for falconers, breeders, and enthusiasts, offering access to distinguished falcon bloodlines and top-tier breeds from around the world. Falcons are available through participating breeders’ pavilions as well as competitive live auction sessions attended by local and international participants. Broadcast on television channels and livestreamed social media platforms, the event reaches a wide global audience and provides enthusiasts with the opportunity to engage with one of the most prominent falconry gatherings of the year.

candidates.title: Saudi International Falcons & Hunting Exhibition
candidates.summary: The Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition is one of the largest events dedicated to falconry and hunting in Saudi and globally. It brings together everything related to falconry and outdoor excursions, from falcons and hunting tools to equipment and gear associated with hunting trips, all within a comprehensive space that allows visitors to explore this field in one place. The exhibition also features platforms showcasing a wide range of brands, alongside accompanying activities and events suitable for families, creating an experience that blends cultural and entertainment elements. The event plays an important role in preserving falconry heritage and raising awareness by offering content that introduces visitors to its history and significance within Saudi’s cultural identity.

candidates.title: Saudi Falcons Club Auction
candidates.summary: The Saudi Falcons Club organizes an annual auction dedicated to locally caught falcons, known as “Al Tarh falcons,” which are captured during the hunting season. The auction is a structured platform that brings falconers together to showcase their falcons in a competitive live bidding environment, enabling reliable buying and selling. The event is broadcast on television channels and digital platforms. The club also provides integrated services for falcon owners, including transportation to the auction venue, along with facilities that organize and enhance the participation experience, all within a framework aimed at developing falcon auctions in Saudi. The auction also contributes to raising awareness about preserving falcon breeds by regulating sales and emphasizing the protection of endangered species.
